words.definition: vt. 管理，治理；施行；给…服药

examples.en: The trust was set up to administer the scholarship fund.
examples.zh: 该信托专为管理奖学金基金而设立。

examples.en: The nurse administered the vaccine to elderly patients first.
examples.zh: 护士优先为老年患者接种疫苗。

words.usage: 正式动词，考点三义：管理 administer a fund；施行 administer the law 执法；给药 administer the drug to sb。派生：administration n. 行政。
collocations: administer a fund 管理基金
administer an exam 主持考试
words.mnemonic: ad(去)+minister(部长) → 部长做事 → 掌管、施行

examples.en: The garment industry employs millions of low-paid workers.
examples.zh: 服装业雇用了数百万低薪工人。

examples.en: Each garment is inspected twice before it is shipped.
examples.zh: 每件衣服发货前都要经过两次检验。

words.usage: 可数名词，正式或服装贸易语境指「一件衣服」，garment industry 服装业为固定搭配；日常口语多说 clothes。相关词 apparel 服装业书面总称。
words.mnemonic: gar(护)+ment → 护体之物 → 衣服（正式词）

examples.en: We stayed at a small inn at the foot of the mountain.
examples.zh: 我们住在山脚下一家小客栈。

examples.en: The old inn has served travelers for more than two centuries.
examples.zh: 这家老客栈接待旅人已两百多年。

words.usage: 可数名词，旧指乡村客栈、小旅馆，今多保留于酒店字号，如 Holiday Inn；文学中 roadside inn 路边客栈常见。派生：innkeeper n. 客栈老板。
collocations: stay at an inn 投宿客栈
words.mnemonic: in+n：住「进」去的店 → 客栈；inner 才是内部

examples.en: The fairy tale ends with the prince breaking the spell.
examples.zh: 童话以王子破除魔咒结尾。

examples.en: Children believed a fairy would exchange coins for their lost teeth.
examples.zh: 孩子们相信仙女会用硬币换走他们掉落的乳牙。

words.usage: 名词仙女、小精灵，fairy tale 童话为最高频搭配；tooth fairy 牙仙为西方儿童文化词；fairy lights 彩灯串。派生：fairyland n. 仙境、极乐之地。
words.mnemonic: fair(美)+y → 美丽小仙子；ferry 是渡船

words.definition: n. 楼梯（含扶手的整段）

examples.en: A spiral staircase leads from the hall to the library.
examples.zh: 一段螺旋楼梯从门厅通向图书馆。

examples.en: The grand marble staircase is the palace's most striking feature.
examples.zh: 宏伟的大理石楼梯是宫殿最醒目的景观。

words.usage: 可数名词，指包括扶手、结构在内的整段楼梯；spiral staircase 螺旋楼梯为描写高频；口语常用 stairs，近义 stairway 泛指楼梯通道。
collocations: a staircase to the attic 通阁楼的楼梯
words.mnemonic: stair(梯级)+case(整体) → 成套楼梯；口语说 stairs

words.definition: n. 螃蟹；脾气坏的人；vi. 抱怨

examples.en: The restaurant is famous for its steamed crab with ginger.
examples.zh: 这家餐馆以姜蒸螃蟹闻名。

examples.en: The crab scuttled sideways into a rock pool before I could catch it.
examples.zh: 我还没抓到，螃蟹就横着钻进了岩石水潭。

words.usage: 名词螃蟹，引申「脾气乖戾的人」；美式口语动词 crab about sth 抱怨某事。赛艇习语 catch a crab 指一桨落空。派生：crabby adj. 易怒的、暴躁的。
collocations: walk sideways like a crab 像螃蟹一样横行
words.mnemonic: 谐音「快跑」→ 螃蟹横着跑；cramp 抽筋勿混

examples.en: She turned on the desk lamp and continued reading.
examples.zh: 她打开台灯继续读书。

examples.en: The only light in the room came from an oil lamp.
examples.zh: 房间里唯一的光亮来自一盏油灯。

words.usage: 可数名词，指带灯罩、可移动的灯具，table lamp 台灯、oil lamp 油灯；泛指光源总称用 light。复合词 lampshade n. 灯罩；street lamp 路灯。
words.mnemonic: lamp 灯、lamb 羔羊、limp 跛行：a、e、i 串记

examples.en: Excessive use of chemical fertilizer pollutes rivers and groundwater.
examples.zh: 化肥的过量使用污染河流与地下水。

examples.en: Farmers are turning to organic fertilizer to restore soil fertility.
examples.zh: 农民正改用有机肥以恢复土壤肥力。

words.usage: 表物质概念不可数，指种类时可数，如 chemical fertilizers 各类化肥。派生：fertile adj. 肥沃的；fertilize vt. 施肥、使受精；fertility n. 肥力。
words.mnemonic: fertile(肥沃)+ize+er → 让田变肥之物 → 肥料

examples.en: The salad was garnished with slices of fresh cucumber.
examples.zh: 沙拉上点缀着新鲜黄瓜片。

examples.en: Cucumber production expanded rapidly under the new irrigation system.
examples.zh: 在新灌溉系统下，黄瓜种植迅速扩大。

words.usage: 可数名词，常与 salad、sandwich 等搭配。习语 as cool as a cucumber 意为镇定自若；复合词 cucumber sandwich 指清淡的黄瓜三明治。
collocations: as cool as a cucumber 泰然自若
words.mnemonic: as cool as a cucumber：清凉冷静如黄瓜

words.definition: n. 公报；新闻简报；病情通报

examples.en: The government issued a bulletin on the flood situation.
examples.zh: 政府就洪水灾情发布了公报。

examples.en: A news bulletin interrupted the programme with the election results.
examples.zh: 新闻快报打断节目播报选举结果。

words.usage: 可数名词，指官方或机构发布的简短公告。搭配 issue a bulletin 发布公报、news bulletin 新闻快报；bulletin board 即布告栏，也是网络论坛 BBS 的全称。

confusables.note: 去掉 in 就是子弹

collocations: issue a bulletin 发布公报
words.mnemonic: bullet（子弹）＋in：飞来的快讯→简报

words.definition: n. 管弦乐队；（美）剧院正厅

examples.en: The orchestra performed Beethoven's Ninth to a full house.
examples.zh: 管弦乐团向满场观众演奏了贝多芬第九交响曲。

examples.en: She has played the violin in the school orchestra for three years.
examples.zh: 她在校管弦乐团拉小提琴已有三年。

words.usage: 集合名词，指管弦乐队整体时谓语可用单数或复数。搭配 conduct an orchestra 指挥乐团、symphony orchestra 交响乐团；the orchestra 在美式英语指剧院正厅。
collocations: conduct an orchestra 指挥乐团
words.mnemonic: 希腊语 orche（舞）＋stra：舞队→乐队

examples.en: She wore a silk blouse with a dark skirt.
examples.zh: 她穿着真丝衬衫配深色裙子。

examples.en: The cotton blouse is easier to wash than the silk one.
examples.zh: 这件棉衬衫比那件真丝的更好洗。

words.usage: 可数名词，多指女式宽松上衣，与男式或中性衬衫 shirt 相对；常用搭配 try on a blouse 试穿。英美读音有别：英 blaʊz 词尾为浊音，美 blaʊs 读清音。

confusables.note: 去掉 b 就是虱子

collocations: wear a blouse 穿女式衬衫
words.mnemonic: 法语借词，本指工装宽松罩衣→女衬衫

examples.en: The farm raises poultry and dairy cattle on a large scale.
examples.zh: 该农场大规模饲养家禽和奶牛。

examples.en: Poultry prices rose sharply before the Spring Festival.
examples.zh: 春节前禽肉价格大幅上涨。

words.usage: 集合名词，不可数：指家禽总称或禽肉，作主语时谓语单复皆可。搭配 poultry farming 养禽业、poultry products 禽类产品。与 livestock 家畜相对。
words.mnemonic: poult（幼禽）＋ry：把幼禽养大→家禽

examples.en: She put the kettle on and made some tea.
examples.zh: 她坐上水壶烧水泡茶。

examples.en: The old kettle whistles loudly when the water boils.
examples.zh: 水开时那把旧壶哨声很响。

words.usage: 可数名词，指烧水壶。短语 put the kettle on 烧水泡茶；习语 a different kettle of fish 截然不同的事；美式英语多说 teakettle。
collocations: put the kettle on 烧水
a different kettle of fish 另一回事
words.mnemonic: 谐音「开透」——壶一开，水就烧透了

words.definition: n. 嘴唇；（坑口、容器的）边

examples.en: She read the letter with a trembling lip.
examples.zh: 她嘴唇颤抖着读完了信。

examples.en: The news was on everyone's lips within hours.
examples.zh: 几小时内这个消息就传遍了众人之口。

words.usage: 可数名词。短语 escape one's lips 脱口而出、on the lips of 在众人流传；习语 pay lip service to 口头支持、bite one's lip 咬唇忍怒。
collocations: pay lip service to 口头上支持
on everyone's lips 众口相传
escape one's lips 脱口而出
words.mnemonic: lip 谐音「裂破」：干裂的嘴唇

examples.en: He pretended not to hear the criticism.
examples.zh: 他假装没听见批评。

examples.en: Many applicants pretend to skills they do not possess.
examples.zh: 许多求职者自称拥有其实并不具备的技能。

words.usage: 接不定式或 that 从句：pretend to do sth、pretend that…；pretend to sth 自称拥有（to 为介词）。名词 pretence，美拼 pretense。
collocations: pretend not to know 假装不知道
words.mnemonic: pre（预先）＋tend（伸展）：先摆姿态→假装

examples.en: Mental arithmetic is a required skill in the entrance examination.
examples.zh: 心算是入学考试的必备技能。

examples.en: The arithmetic of the plan simply does not work.
examples.zh: 这项计划的账算下来根本行不通。

words.usage: 名词不可数，指算术这门学科，也可指数目上的计算结果。作形容词时重音后移，读 ˌærɪθˈmetɪk，如 arithmetic progression 等差数列。派生 arithmetician 算术家。
words.mnemonic: 词根 arithm（数）＋etic：关于数的→算术

examples.en: The volcano emits huge quantities of sulfur dioxide.
examples.zh: 这座火山喷出大量二氧化硫。

examples.en: Sulfur is a raw material for making sulfuric acid.
examples.zh: 硫是制造硫酸的原料。

words.usage: 不可数名词，化学元素硫；美式拼 sulfur，英式多拼 sulphur，读音相同。搭配 sulfur dioxide 二氧化硫、sulfuric acid 硫酸；工业上还用于橡胶硫化处理。
words.mnemonic: 火山喷出的臭气含硫——S 元素 sulfur

words.definition: n. 小器具；小装置；小玩意儿

examples.en: The kitchen is equipped with every modern gadget.
examples.zh: 这间厨房配备了各种新式小家电。

examples.en: He bought a gadget that peels apples automatically.
examples.zh: 他买了一个自动削苹果皮的小装置。

words.usage: 可数名词，指小巧新奇的小装置，含喜爱或戏谑色彩，比 device 更口语。常用复数 gadgets 指各类装备。搭配 the latest kitchen gadgets 最新厨房小家电。
collocations: the latest gadget 最新小玩意
words.mnemonic: gad（闲逛）＋get：逛街就想买的小玩意

examples.en: The coin is made of copper and nickel.
examples.zh: 这枚硬币由铜和镍铸成。

examples.en: The candy cost only a nickel in those days.
examples.zh: 那时候糖果只要五分钱。

words.usage: 不可数指金属镍；可数指美式五分镍币。习语 nickel-and-dime 形容在小钱上斤斤计较、零敲碎打。派生 nickel-plated 镀镍的；五分硬币口语叫 a nickel。
words.mnemonic: 谐音「你抠」——五分镍币，真抠门
